description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of data sources within a combined training set, and it contains 13 distinct slices representing different data sources. Each slice is labeled with the data source name and displays a corresponding percentage value. The slices, proceeding roughly clockwise from the largest, are NQ (blue, 31.3%), FEVER (orange, 16.1%), SNLI (green, 15.4%), MULTINLI (light green, 11.3%), VITAMINC (yellow, 13.0%), ANLI (red, 4.6%), FACTCC (dark orange, 2.6%), ENTFA (brown, 1.8%), SCIFACT (teal, 0.1%), PUBHEALTH (pink, 0.5%), MULTIFC (purple, 0.5%), and SCIITAIL (light pink, 1.2%). The chart includes a legend listing each data source and its corresponding color, and percentage labels are displayed directly within each slice. The slices appear to be ordered by descending size, though this is a visual observation and not explicitly stated.
caption_used: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of data sources in the combined training set, comprising 13 slices. Each slice represents a specific data source with distinct labels, colors, and percentage values. The largest data source is NQ, accounting for approximately 31.3% of the dataset, followed by FEVER at 16.1%. SNLI and MULTINLI are the next largest contributors, with 15.4% and 11.3%, respectively. Notably, VITAMINC shows a steady decline in its contribution compared to previous years, now accounting for only 8.0% of the dataset. Additionally, SCIFACT and PUBHEALTH are among the smallest contributors, with SCIFACT slightly exceeding PUBHEALTH at 0.7% and 0.5%, respectively. The chart provides a clear overview of the relative proportions of each data source in the training set.
